title: Wireless Game Controller for Most Consoles and PCs, Dual Vibration
description:
A comfortable wireless gamepad with responsive sticks and triggers for console, PC and mobile gaming.
• Bluetooth 5.0 plus 2.4 GHz USB receiver; works with most consoles, PCs and smartphones
• Dual vibration motors, 6-axis motion sensor and turbo function
• Built-in 800 mAh battery for up to 12 hours of play; charges via USB-C
• Textured grips and 2 programmable back buttons
• USB-C cable included

title: Gaming Headset with Noise-Cancelling Mic and RGB Lights, for Consoles and PC
description:
An over-ear gaming headset with deep bass and a flexible microphone, so you hear footsteps clearly and talk to your team without background noise.
• 50 mm drivers and soft memory-foam ear cushions
• Adjustable noise-cancelling microphone with mute switch on the ear cup
• 3.5 mm jack for most consoles, PCs, laptops and phones; USB plug powers the RGB lights
• In-line volume control and 2 m braided cable
• Self-adjusting padded headband, weight 320 g

title: Dual Controller Charging Dock with LED Indicators and Swappable Tips
description:
Keep two wireless controllers charged and tidy on your desk or TV stand: just dock them after playing.
• Charges 2 controllers at once in about 3 hours
• USB-C and Micro-USB connector tips included to suit most wireless controllers
• LED glows red while charging and green when full
• Powered by the included USB cable from a console, PC or USB adapter (adapter not included)
• Non-slip base, size 15 × 9 × 5 cm

title: RGB Gaming Mouse, Wired, 7200 DPI, 7 Programmable Buttons
description:
A lightweight wired gaming mouse with precise tracking and side buttons you can set for in-game actions.
• Optical sensor with 6 DPI steps from 800 to 7200
• 7 programmable buttons with on-board memory
• Customisable RGB lighting with 7 effects
• Braided 1.8 m USB-A cable and smooth PTFE feet
• Ergonomic right-handed shape, weight 85 g

title: Folding Wooden Chess Set 39 cm with Felt-Lined Storage, Ages 6+
description:
A classic wooden chess set whose board folds in half to store all 32 pieces, ready for family game nights or travel.
• 39 × 39 cm folding board with inlaid squares and magnetic clasp
• Hand-finished wooden pieces, king height 7.5 cm
• Felt-lined compartments inside the board keep pieces from rattling
• 2 spare queens and a rule sheet included
• For 2 players, ages 6+; not suitable for children under 3 years due to small parts

title: 2-in-1 Ludo and Snakes & Ladders Wooden Board Game, Ages 4+
description:
Two family favourites on one reversible wooden board, great for teaching young children to count, take turns and enjoy some friendly competition.
• Reversible 30 × 30 cm wooden board: ludo on one side, snakes and ladders on the other
• 16 coloured wooden pawns and 2 dice
• Cotton drawstring bag for the pieces
• For 2–4 players, ages 4+; not suitable for children under 3 years due to small parts

title: Family Treasure Hunt Board Game, 2–4 Players, Ages 6+
description:
Race through the jungle, collect treasure cards and dodge surprise traps in this family adventure game. A turning section of the board changes the route every game.
• 50 × 50 cm game board, 4 explorer pawns, 60 treasure and trap cards and 2 dice
• Learn in 5 minutes; a game takes about 30 minutes
• For 2–4 players, ages 6+
• Rules in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian
• Not suitable for children under 3 years due to small parts

title: Waterproof Plastic Playing Cards, 2 Decks, Standard Poker Size
description:
Durable plastic playing cards that survive spilled drinks, beach trips and countless rounds without bending or fraying.
• 2 decks of 54 cards (52 plus 2 jokers), one with red backs and one with blue
• 100 % PVC, waterproof and wipe-clean
• Standard poker size 63 × 88 mm with large, easy-to-read indices
• Each deck in its own plastic case; ages 6+

title: Party Question Card Game for Teens and Adults, 300 Cards, Ages 14+
description:
Break the ice at parties, dinners and game nights with 300 funny, curious and thought-provoking questions that get everyone talking.
• 300 question cards in 3 categories: light-hearted, deep and daring
• Simple rules: draw a card, then answer or take a forfeit
• For 3–10 players, ages 14+
• Sturdy magnetic gift box, 10 × 7 × 7 cm

title: Colour Matching Card Game for Families, 108 Cards, Ages 6+
description:
A quick twist on the classic crazy-eights game: match colours and numbers, play action cards to skip or reverse, and race to empty your hand first.
• 108 cards: numbers in 4 colours plus skip, reverse, draw and wild cards
• Learn in minutes; a round takes about 15 minutes
• For 2–10 players, ages 6+
• Coated cards in a sturdy tuck box, rules in 5 languages

title: 1000-Piece Jigsaw Puzzle for Adults, Colourful Scenes, 70 × 50 cm
description:
A relaxing 1000-piece puzzle with a detailed, colourful picture, made from thick recycled board so the pieces fit snugly and stay put.
• Finished size 70 × 50 cm
• 2 mm thick pieces with an anti-glare matt finish
• Reference poster of the picture included
• Ages 12+; not suitable for children under 3 years due to small parts

title: Wooden Alphabet Puzzle Board with 26 Chunky Letter Pieces, Ages 3+
description:
A colourful wooden puzzle that helps little ones learn their letters while practising hand–eye coordination.
• 26 capital-letter pieces with matching pictures underneath
• Thick, smooth-sanded wood finished with water-based paints
• Board size 40 × 30 cm
• Ages 3+; not suitable for children under 3 years due to small parts

title: Wooden Labyrinth Maze Puzzle with Steel Ball, Brain Teaser, Ages 6+
description:
Tilt and turn the wooden board to guide the steel ball along twisting paths to the centre: a calm, screen-free challenge for kids and adults.
• Wooden frame with a clear acrylic cover, so the ball stays inside
• 3 routes of increasing difficulty in one maze
• Diameter 20 cm (round) or 20 × 20 cm (square)
• Ages 6+

title: Wooden Building Blocks Set, 100 Pieces in Bright Colours, Ages 3+
description:
A big set of smooth wooden blocks for building towers, houses and bridges, encouraging creative play and an early feel for shapes and balance.
• 100 pieces in 12 shapes, including arches, cylinders and triangles
• Solid pine wood with water-based paint
• Pieces from 3 to 10 cm, sized for small hands
• Cotton storage bag included
• Ages 3+

title: Fashion Doll 30 cm with 3 Outfits, Shoes and Accessories, Ages 3+
description:
A posable fashion doll with a wardrobe of mix-and-match outfits for endless dress-up stories.
• 30 cm doll with 11 movable joints and long, brushable hair
• 3 outfits including a pink party dress, plus 3 pairs of shoes
• Hairbrush, handbag and necklace included
• Ages 3+; not suitable for children under 3 years due to small parts

title: Realistic Dinosaur Figures Set, 12 Pieces, 10–15 cm, Ages 3+
description:
A herd of detailed, hand-painted dinosaurs for small-world play, the sandpit and bath time.
• 12 different species, each 10–15 cm long
• Solid soft-touch PVC that is easy to wash
• Name card with fun facts for each dinosaur
• Ages 3+

title: Remote Control Monster Truck 1:16, 2.4 GHz, Off-Road, Rechargeable, Ages 8+
description:
A tough off-road truck with big, springy tyres that climbs over grass, gravel and small obstacles at up to 20 km/h.
• 1:16 scale, 4-wheel drive with independent spring suspension
• 2.4 GHz remote with up to 80 m range, so several trucks can race together
• 2 rechargeable batteries give up to 40 minutes of play; USB charging cable included
• Remote runs on 2 × AA batteries (not included)
• Ages 8+

title: DIY Programmable Robot Car Kit with Sensors, STEM Toy, Ages 10+
description:
Build your own robot car from the motors up, then program it to follow lines, avoid obstacles or drive by remote control from a phone.
• Kit includes chassis, 2 geared motors, wheels, controller board, line and distance sensors, wires and screwdriver
• Program with drag-and-drop blocks in the free app, then move on to text coding
• Step-by-step illustrated building guide
• Runs on 4 × AA batteries (not included)
• Ages 10+; adult supervision recommended

title: Soft Teddy Bear 40 cm with Bow Tie, Classic Plush Toy, Ages 3+
description:
A cuddly, classic teddy bear with soft fur and a smart bow tie, a sweet gift for birthdays and holidays.
• 40 cm tall (28 cm sitting)
• Super-soft polyester plush with polyester fibre filling
• Embroidered eyes and nose
• Surface-wash with a damp cloth
• Ages 3+

title: Kids' Kite with 50 m Line and Winding Handle, Easy to Fly, Ages 6+
description:
A bright, easy-flying kite that lifts off even in light winds, perfect for beach days, parks and family outings.
• 110 × 70 cm ripstop polyester sail with fibreglass frame
• 50 m line on a winding handle
• Long tail for steady flight
• Folds into the included storage bag
• Ages 6+; fly away from power lines and roads
